title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1970-02-02

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a gem‑filled fragment featuring a stellar Dark Star > St. Stephen transition.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as an excellent soundboard source with crystal‑clear fidelity, making the brief Dark Star into St. Stephen segment shine. Reviewers highlight the beauty of those two tunes and consider this partial set a true gem despite its brevity.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are positive, with multiple 5‑star ratings noting superb soundboard quality and standout performances of Dark Star and St. Stephen; no criticisms were raised.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as crisp, clear and comparable to a fresh afternoon soundboard mix; no issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Partial excerpt flows seamlessly from Dark Star into St. Stephen, a transition that reviewers single out as the highlight of this recording.
